summary: Console dimension breakdown drops series when viewing >14d time ranges
description:
Issue summary: When a customer opens the Console dashboard "Redwood API - Usage by client_id' and expands the timeframe beyond 14 days (e.g., 30d or 90d), multiple dimension series (client_id / route) disappear from the stacked breakdown. Impact: GreenPath AI reports that their monthly billing and SLA dashboards undercount unique clients by ~18% when using 30d range. Environment: prod (us-east), observed across multiple orgs but reproduced with GreenPath account. Steps to reproduce: 1) Open Console > Dashboards > 'Redwood API - Usage by client_id'. 2) Select time range 7d: all client_id series present. 3) Switch to 30d: top client series remain, medium/low-volume client_id series vanish. 4) Inspect raw events export for same timespan -> events present for vanished client_ids. Expected: Dimension breakdown should show series for all client_ids with nonzero activity (subject to sampling threshold). Actual: Several client_id series are missing from the visualization for ranges >14d despite raw events showing activity. Observations / logs: - Dashboard query id: q-ff72c3a - Raw event export (CSV) attached by customer shows ~120 distinct client_ids for 30d window. Console breakdown shows ~45 series. - Query profiler shows fallback to rollup index (rollup_v2) for ranges >14d. - Timeseries-store compaction run logs around 2026-03-09 show rollup job 'rollup_v2:topk' executed with top_k=50. - Slack thread: #support-greenpath link: https://slack.redwood.com/archives/C07SUPPORT/p1652xxxx - Customer impact: Monthly reporting and billing alerts are undercounted, causing finance/CS tickets.

Please triage to analytics/runtime team; customer needs a short-term workaround and long-term fix.
comments: 2026-03-10 Maya Thompson: Created ticket after CS call with GreenPath. Customer provided raw CSV and dashboard screenshot (links added to attachments). Notified SRE on-call.

2026-03-10 Diego Alvarez: Acknowledged. Initial hypothesis: rollup top-k truncation is hiding lower-volume series when rollup index is used for >14d queries. Will reproduce in staging and check rollup config.

2026-03-11 Diego Alvarez: Reproduced locally by replaying event stream. Confirmed that long-range queries are routed to rollup index that applies top_k=50. When unique dimension cardinality > 50, lower-volume keys are aggregated into 'other' and UI currently drops 'other' series (bug).

2026-03-11 SRE (Priya Rao): Found compaction job 'rollup_v2:topk' ran with default top_k and an aggressive TTL for dimension values. Raised short-term mitigation: re-run compaction with top_k=200 for affected orgs and invalidate dashboard cache for 30m.

2026-03-12 Diego Alvarez: Deployed config change in staging to increase top_k on rollup queries and updated UI logic to render 'other' bucket as collapsed series rather than dropping it. Need product sign-off before prod rollout.

2026-03-12 CS (Ethan Li): Communicated interim workaround to GreenPath: use raw events export for full cardinality and switch dashboard timeframe to <=14d for accurate per-client breakdown until fix is deployed.
2026-03-13 Diego Alvarez: Created GH PR to make UI include 'other' bucket and add telemetry when drop occurs: github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4721. Marking for hotfix release if QA passes.

2026-03-13 Maya Thompson: Customer confirmed that after temporary compaction re-run (performed by SRE), their 30d dashboard regained ~95% of missing series for one org. They still see some low-volume tails missing for 90d ranges.
2026-03-13 Product (Anika Bose): Requested product decision on default top_k for rollups and whether 'other' should be expanded-by-default or collapsed.
investigation_notes: Hypothesis 1: Rollup aggregator uses a top_k selection during compaction that discards low-volume dimension values, and the console UI does not render the 'other' bucket for breakdown charts. Evidence: rollup logs show top_k=50; raw export shows >120 distinct keys.

Hypothesis 2: Query router switches to rollup index for any range >14d; mismatch between rollup binning/aggregation window and UI's chart points causes missing intermediate series when series fall below per-bucket threshold.
Repro steps executed in staging: replayed 45m of production-like traffic -> reproduced missing series for 30d view. Adjusting rollup top_k to 200 restored series in staging.
Telemetry: Add a gauge to dashboard queries to emit whether result came from 'raw' or 'rollup' index and the rollup top_k value used. This will speed triage for future reports.
SRE note: Compaction re-run for affected orgs resolved majority of cases; global hotfix needed to prevent recurrence as compaction job resets to default top_k during upgrades.
resolution: Workaround: SRE re-ran rollup compaction with top_k=200 for GreenPath's orgs and invalidated dashboard caches; CS shared raw-export workflow for full cardinality checks. Long-term fix: (1) Increase default rollup top_k to 200 and make it configurable per-org, (2) change Console breakdown charts to render an 'other' bucket instead of dropping series, and (3) add telemetry flag for rollup vs raw source. GH PR #4721 implements UI change and telemetry; rollup default change requires infra deploy + migration steps. Planned timeline: hotfix UI rollout (canary on 2026-03-15); infra change planned for 2026-03-22 after migration runbook. Follow-up task: INT-430 (rollup migration runbook) created.
next_steps: Approve GH PR #4721 and run QA on canary orgs (assigned to Diego).
SRE to schedule controlled compaction migration and update compaction job defaults (Runbook in INT-430).
Product to decide default top_k and 'other' display behavior and document in Console UX spec.
CS to notify GreenPath of planned windows and confirm whether final migration resolved 90d tails.
Add dashboard-level telemetry to surface when results are from rollup and top_k used.
